Lets a trainer attempt a Capture Roll to catch a Pokémon. This pokéball has a built-in timer. You can take the Utilize action to activate it. On your next turn, you can take the Throw Pokéball action, reducing the capture DC by 15. If you don't, the timer deactivates and the ball must be activated again.
No longer requires concentration, with a simpler mechanic.

Only licensed trainers are permitted to capture Pokémon, and this license identifies you as having such authorization. It also allows trainers to gain access to special services at Pokémon centers and to purchase goods at the Poké Mart.
